about_the_game:
Looking to get more out of your time on Arrakis?

Dune: Awakening’s Season Pass includes 4 DLCs, starting with Wildlife of Arrakis, which will be released together with the game, and introduces statues of iconic creatures that live on Dune.

Secure your access to all 4 DLCs with the Dune: Awakening Season Pass!
